title: Reduce the many-axis prime producer setup bound (no κ)
body:
## Summary

A scoped constructive complexity proof reduces the written setup bound for ToikY's PR4029 prime producer, while retaining its bands, ordered source stream, owned scratch erasure and O(D ell+ell) backing. Here r=2^ell and D=d-1.

```text
before: O(r^2 ell^2 + D ell)
after:  O((r/d+1) sqrt(r) ell^2 + D ell)
```

On the cited abundance domain ell>=2^32, 2<=d<=ell^334, the new bound is O(r^(3/2) ell^2/d+D ell). Each of the two scale bands is scanned once up to its quota. Square-root trial division and sequential table consumption are classical. The new result is their explicit space-preserving construction and complete bound at this source contract, including arithmetic, output, erasure and head returns.

This is a partial new construction toward PR4029 Open next question 1. The predecessor abundance theorem and band-to-guard implications are cited premises, not audited or replayed. Prime setup was already subleading; no new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Credit ToikY / PR4029, Cinna Davis / PR3319 and source08/Harvey--van der Hoeven, Jose Manuel / PR3935, Tekalign / PR4024, Chafik Boukhalfa, JosieElliston, Fiori, Kadiri and Swidinsky. Existing source files and credit lines are unchanged. The contribution was produced by Nick Petalas.

## Evidence

- The complete two-band candidate envelope is r/(8d)+2; each candidate needs at most ceil(sqrt(r)) square comparisons and remainders. PROOF.md gives the universal argument and full tape/backing bill.
- All 65,535 integers 2..65,536 agree with a new Eratosthenes oracle; 8,192 exact interval fixtures pass.
- All 1,270 small producer requests are enumerated: 83 successes, 370 emitted source words and 1,187 explicitly checked insufficient-supply failures. Successful requests execute 2,671 candidate tests and 30,011 remainders. Output order, the implicit final flag, distinctness, operation envelopes, table erasure and stream head-return counts pass.
- Thirteen malformed/semantic controls reject, three prime/square boundaries pass and one extra exhausted request rejects.
- CPython 3.12.15 / macOS arm64: warning-strict normal and optimized direct checks, metadata/pins, registered replay, exact committed bytes and source history pass. Each registered command was timed locally, 0.141 and 0.146 seconds, for timeout sizing only. Both direct modes also pass in a read-only Git-free six-file copy. These are enumerated work counts and a written complexity bound, not a measured speedup.

Exact reproduction from the repository root, using only the standard library:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/two-band-prime-producer/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/two-band-prime-producer/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/two-band-prime-producer
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/two-band-prime-producer --check-source-history
```

Other machines may substitute a CPython 3.12 executable. The direct verifier prints PASS_TWO_BAND_PRIME_PRODUCER in a generated receipt binding all six package files. Source pins are historical provenance, with no runtime predecessor import. The package runner prints PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE; the publication preflight prints PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES and checks canonical base 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a.

## Limitations

The finite reference uses host integers, not literal encoded arithmetic or native instructions. Its implementation is bounded to ell<=16 and D<=32; the universal construction rests on the written proof. It does not execute an astronomical prime search, production_axis, production_common, complete numerical tensor recovery or a predecessor scientific suite. The analytic abundance result is assumed at its stated domain. Ordinary erasure of owned scratch is allowed; reversible dirty uncomputation is not claimed.

Complete encoded TensorPlan/CRT integration, a literal fixed-tape trace, physical reserve, native operators, Gaussian errors, compiler closure, exact recovery and supplier admission remain unrun/open. All five selected framework assumptions retain their status. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

1. Emit this algorithm at the actual encoded TensorPlan/CRT source interface. First lower square comparison and binary long division to one named tape backend, preserving every scratch word and borrowed head. A complete instruction trace and consumer are missing.
2. Seek a complete changed transform with a lower dominant bill, retaining precision, native, routing and recovery costs. This setup improvement alone cannot move kappa.

## Related open work

- No open PR specifically studying the PR4029 two-band source producer or this setup bound was found in the refreshed targeted search. Main, merged work and live claims were also checked; unpublished work and arbitrary historical diffs remain coverage limits.
- PR1786 studies fine source-prime padding at a different band and outer parameter family. Its setup is context; this result neither audits that theorem nor changes its invoice.

Before DONE, the fourteen other account open PRs created since the CLAIM were inspected: #6437 through #6443 and #6445 through #6451. None studies the PR4029 two-band prime producer or computes a competing setup bound. No additional computation checked another contribution.

## CI notes

Both `plan` and `replay (research/two-band-prime-producer)` passed in [run 41544180377](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41544180377) at head `14c9d385500c648b2fd28964112b4eff7e73cf10`. The completed checks were read once with `gh pr checks 6444 --repo CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds`; run metadata confirms completed success at that exact head. Hosted replay passed both registered normal and optimized commands. All registered checks, metadata/pins, exact committed bytes and declared source history also passed locally. This certifies execution of the scoped automated checks, not independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance of the universal argument.

## Merge danger

This adds only six files under research/two-band-prime-producer. Reverting the package is straightforward. Shared code, frozen sources and selected-result records are unchanged.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19362373) records the same delivered scope.
